title: Page Edit Lock Status Response
description: Status of the edit lock of a page (live sync contract C9). Returned by GET, POST and DELETE /admin/pages/{page_id}/lock and POST /admin/pages/{page_id}/lock/take-over, and as the data of a 409 page_locked answer. Per caller: `mine` is true only for the caller. holder, expires_at and idle_expires_at are null when held is false.

page_id.description: The page the lock belongs to.

held.description: True while someone holds the lock.

mine.description: True when the caller is the holder.

holder.description: The holder, or null when the lock is free.

expires_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 moment the lease ends unless the holder renews it (120 s after the last renewal).

idle_expires_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 moment the lease ends when the holder writes nothing more (15 minutes after the last draft write, or after the acquisition).
